images.alt: A bank of fog lies over part of Mount Cook Aerodrome, with sunrise visible in the background, and frost on the ground and nearby buildings in the foreground. A label in the top left reads "Mount Cook Aerodrome, 7:36am, 20 May 2026"

post.text:
F-f-freezing fog!

Usually frost scavenges all the moisture needed for fog, but enough water vapour allows both to form, despite Mount Cook Aerodrome reaching -7.8°C by 8am 🥶

Wind and cloud build up today, bringing an end to the days and days of freezing fog for parts of the South Island 🥳
